note: Megabonk's own animation clips on the Megabonk survivors (MegabonkAnimator). Each Megabonk character's AnimatorController (its Animator on the character prefab in Megabonk's sharedassets1) holds five generic clips; a clip takes the first role whose clipWords appear in its name. Megabonk has no attack clips (weapons fire by themselves), so attacking keeps the idle/run animation. The clips each character uses are in characters.json (mbClips).

rows.plays: moving on the ground; playback speed follows speed / run_speed (0.6x to 1.8x)
in the air while rising faster than anim_fall_speed (played once, holds its last frame)
sliding. Megabonk characters have no slide clip of their own, only the rail Grind pose (crouched, gliding), which stands in for it (Bush has a real Sliding clip)
